test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All baskets are fruits.

Some fruits are utensils.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some utensils are baskets.

II. Some utensils are fruits.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8afdd4726b92a5fac90a8943c2b9509fb88caaf152de9f37340479a6c19b1836.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some utensils are baskets. → Does not Follow (As, there is no definite relation between utensils and baskets. Hence, false)

II. Some utensils are fruits. → **Follow** (Some fruits are utensils)

Hence, **Only conclusion II follows**.
